content: I can't believe you're being so paranoid and accusing me of cheating on you. I would never do that to someone I care about. You're just being insecure and irrational. Why can't you just trust me and stop overreacting? This is all in your head and you need to get a grip on reality. I love you and would never do anything to hurt you. You're just pushing me away with these ridiculous accusations.
